componentDescription:
Semantic wrapper for one loading row of the Rich Tree View.

It renders a `li` element with the `role`, `aria` attributes, indentation and
height of a tree item, so custom loading UIs stay accessible and aligned.
Without children, it renders the default skeleton placeholders.

children.description: The content of the loading row. When not provided, the default skeleton placeholders are rendered.

classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

ownerState.description: State of the loading row, forwarded by the itemLoader slot. The component does not render it.

checkbox.nodeName: the checkbox placeholder element of the default content

iconContainer.nodeName: the icon gutter element of the default content

label.nodeName: the label placeholder element of the default content

root.description: Styles applied to the root element.
